description: The bar chart illustrates the "Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)". The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying four models in the following order: "Qwen2.5-7b-1M", "Internlm3-8b", "ProLong-8b", and "Qwen2.5-7b", with the labels slightly rotated. The vertical axis represents the value, using a linear scale with an implied range from 0 to 100, featuring numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80). The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each of the four main categories on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of five adjacent bars. According to the legend, these five bars represent different attributes distinguished by color: a teal bar corresponding to an unlabeled legend entry marked with a solid grey rectangle, a peach bar for "hobby", a blue-grey bar for "university", a pink bar for "major", and a light green bar for "birthdate". Within the "Qwen2.5-7b-1M" group, all bars show high values, ranging from approximately 87 for "university" to the tallest bar in the chart at roughly 95 for "major". The "Internlm3-8b" group shows values ranging from about 54 for "university" to 89 for "birthdate". The "ProLong-8b" group displays values from approximately 29 for "major" to 84 for "birthdate". The "Qwen2.5-7b" group contains the shortest bars in the chart, with values ranging from roughly 3 for both "university" and the unlabeled teal category to about 16 for "birthdate". The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order within the groups or across the horizontal axis, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading or outlining applied to any specific bars.
